verdict.rationale: Shortwave surfaces AI output from the user's own email data directly in the app. Instant Summaries appear at the top of threads, Ghostwriter offers tab-to-complete drafting suggestions, and the AI assistant can search the full email history, read threads and check the calendar. It also flags important emails and todos in one click. TechCrunch's coverage of the AI summaries (via HN) independently corroborates the summary feature. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the quality or accuracy of the insights and suggestions, and documentation of cross-mailbox analytical insights beyond per-thread summaries and todo detection.
